settings.text: with love, from a kitchen table

Dear Wild is a subscription for people who like their pages blank and their mail worth opening. Once a month, we illustrate an animal, print it as a cover for a brand-new journal, cut a matching sticker sheet, and choose a charity working to look after that animal in the wild.

There's no studio tour here, no faces behind the brand — just careful, hand-drawn work and a genuine soft spot for creatures that need a bit of help.

Slow and handmade. Every cover starts as a drawing, not a stock photo. Give as you go. A portion of every order goes to that month's charity, tracked in the open on our Impact page. Blank pages, no pressure. Journals with no prompts, no rules — just room to think.
